---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the documents, diagrams, or links is wrong or broken
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
---

**Where did you find it?**
- [ ] Case study (`ES/safeguards-case-study.md`)
- [ ] Working-method (`ES/docs/`)
- [ ] Installation guide (`ES/instalaciones/`)
- [ ] Templates or work orders (`ES/plantillas/`, `ES/fichas-de-encargo/`)
- [ ] Diagrams (`diagrams/`)
- [ ] README or another top-level file
- [ ] Other: ____

**What is wrong?**
A clear description: a typo, an unclear passage, a broken link, a factual error, a diagram that does not render.

**Where exactly?**
File and, if you can, the section heading or a short quote, so it is easy to locate.

**What would be correct instead?**
If you already know the fix or the right wording, share it here.
